The '''Trandoshan suppressor pistol''' was a a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]] that fired electric charges, used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was manufactured with the intent of subduing individuals without causing too much damage. Much to the Trandoshan's delight, the weapon caused excruciating pain when hit.

The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tempal B'uncho]] rewarded a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with a suppressor pistol for hunting down and killing escaped [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] slaves on the [[Rryatt Trail]].
